Use case: style-transfer. Asset: one transparent-background medieval RPG dialogue portrait, designed on a coarse 74 x 100 pixel canvas. Substantively redraw reference 1; do not merely crop or enlarge its head. Reference 1 is ONLY the named character identity. References 2 through 5 (Mara, Iwo, Leiya, Tore) are ONLY the target portrait visual language and head-to-canvas scale, never new identities.
Compose a head-dominant portrait in a 74:100 rectangle: complete head covering, complete hair silhouette, complete visible ear, cheek and chin, very short neck and a thin strip of work-clothing collar. Large face rather than large hat. Natural three-quarter turn toward viewer left. Head and face fill most of the canvas; reserve genuine clear transparent safety margins on top and both sides, about 2 native pixels, and 2 bottom pixels. Do not crop hair, headscarf ties, ears or collar. Collar and shoulders confined to bottom 10-14% of portrait. The facial landmarks and mouth should sit low enough that the head, not chest, dominates.
Pixel medium: emulate the four reference portraits in chunky deliberate connected pixel clusters, restrained dark outlines, broad angular nose planes, cheekbone and jaw planes. Use at most 32 muted visible colors for the entire asset, no dithering, no gradients, no antialias haze, no painterly smoothness, no HD-2D lighting. Use small narrow dark eyes with tiny muted beige sclera, no large white eyes, no anime lashes, no doll/chibi face. Keep the nose, cheekbone and brow shapes substantial at 1x. Face must communicate an ordinary adult's lived experience and unique temperament, no generic glamour. Avoid tiny scattered pixel noise, random holes in hair, oversized shoulders or long neck. Genuine transparent background, only the single portrait, no text/frame/UI, props/hands/full torso/other people.
Character identity: Xiyou / 溪悠, YOS-NPC-XIYOU, a WOMAN around forty, an ordinary downstream resident worried about usable household water. Preserve reference 1's dark chestnut side-parted swept wavy hair, cream/ivory work headscarf tied behind, visible ear, warm tan complexion, reserved firmly closed mouth, and concerned defensive side glance. Render her clearly around 40 with broad strong cheekbones, weathered brow tension and modest under-eye/eye-corner creases, not a young apprentice or elderly crone. Distinctly fuller, squarer and more firmly set face than a soft younger weaver. Current character card supersedes old outfit: worn water-resistant olive wool short work jacket with a narrow rust-brown undercollar and a small damp gray-beige wrung cloth over ONE shoulder edge. Preserve cream headscarf and olive/rust clothing family from identity reference while making the jacket practical, not a flowing cloak. No bucket or other props in the portrait. Her concern is credible and restrained, not a villain caricature or sneer. Do not visually declare water safe, all migrants guilty, or the story resolved.
